newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat futures close up, Dec sets high.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat futures close up, Dec sets high.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed strongly higher, led by gains in KCBT hard red wheat, and a new contract high was set in the December, traders said.
The new high for December is $4.65 per bushel, above the previous high of $4.54 set Thursday.
The market was boosted by concerns of reports of crop losses in the U.S. and a forecast for dry weather in France, traders said.
Again there were persistent references to talk last week's freeze in the Plains may have harmed up to 200 million bushels of wheat.

Thursday's action by the EU to halt its weekly export tender for wheat and news French weather forecasters Friday predicted another five days without rain across most of the country's farm districts contributed to the advances.
MGE spring wheat futures closed eight to 12-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with May up 11-3/4 at $4.63-3/4.
MGE wheat futures volume was estimated at 37.743 million bushels, above the 34.924 million traded Thursday.
MGE barley futures closed 0.05 to 0.15 cents per cwt higher, with May up 0.08 at $6.65 per cwt.
